description: [$0.01 USDC per call via x402] Request a home-service quote from MuslimTasker (ID-verified local taskers for plumbing, electrical, handyman, cleaning, moving, repairs, remodels; United States and Canada). Submit the customer's full contact details and the job; MuslimTasker contacts the customer directly, usually within 1 business day, with a quote. Incomplete submissions return 400 with the missing fields and are not charged. REFERRAL BOUNTY: when a contractor accepts the lead, the wallet that paid for this call earns $10 USDC (paid weekly); check /api/muslimtasker/status for bounty status.

address.description: Street address where the work is needed (house/apartment number and street)

agent_contact.description: Email or URL where MuslimTasker can reach the agent operator

agent_name.description: Name of the AI agent or platform submitting the request

budget.description: Customer's budget or expectation, e.g. '$150-250' or 'needs quote'

callback_url.description: Optional https URL; MuslimTasker POSTs a JSON status update to it whenever the lead status changes

category.description: Service category: plumbing, electrical, handyman, cleaning, moving, furniture-assembly, tv-mounting, painting, yard-work, appliance-repair, hvac, roofing, remodel, general-contracting, emergency-repair, other (default: other)

contact_preference.description: How the customer prefers to be contacted: call, text, whatsapp or email (default: call)

customer_consent.description: Must be 'true': the customer has agreed to be contacted by MuslimTasker at the email and phone given

customer_email.description: Customer's email address (MuslimTasker will send the quote here)

customer_name.description: Customer's full name (as they want to be addressed)

customer_phone.description: Customer's phone number with country code, e.g. +1 407 555 0100 (MuslimTasker will call or text)

notes.description: Anything else: gate codes, pets, parking, photos (URLs), access instructions

preferred_date.description: Preferred date YYYY-MM-DD, or a range/notes

preferred_language.description: Customer's preferred language, e.g. English, Arabic, Urdu (default English)

preferred_time.description: Preferred time window, e.g. morning, 2-5pm, weekends

task.description: Detailed description of the job (what, where in the home, what is broken, sizes, materials), at least 20 characters

urgency.description: emergency (same day), urgent (within 48 h), normal (default), flexible

name: muslimtasker_quote_request
